verification.notes: The available flight logs support SU-BTT’s route but contain no passenger identities or counts. The originating source is anonymous, and no passenger manifest or independent documentary corroboration has been produced. The legacy false determination relied on a timing correction and lack of foreign-involvement evidence, neither of which disproves this distinct passenger claim. Search was attempted; the claim remains unverifiable.
